onHand.intro: How much of each material you have in each branch, from its first count on.
onHand.intro_food: How much of each ingredient and supply you have in each branch, from its first count on.
onHand.intro_factory: How much of each raw material you have in each branch, from its first count on.
onHand.intro_retail: How much of your goods you have in each branch, from each item's first count on.
onHand.lockedNote: Values are hidden: your role doesn't show costs.

empty.title: Start tracking your stock
empty.body: Pick a few materials to start and count them in every branch on the same day. From that count on, BizCost follows how much you have, and values it at the average of your last 90 days of purchases, so your product costs don't jump.
empty.body_food: Pick a few ingredients and supplies to start (milk, beans, cups…) and count them in every branch on the same day. From that count on, BizCost follows how much you have, and values it at the average of your last 90 days of purchases, so your product costs don't jump.
empty.body_factory: Pick a few raw materials to start and count them in every branch on the same day. From that count on, BizCost follows how much you have, and values it at the average of your last 90 days of purchases, so your product costs don't jump.
empty.body_retail: Pick a few of your goods to start and count them in every branch on the same day. From that count on, BizCost follows how much you have, and values it at the average of your last 90 days of purchases, so your product costs don't jump.
empty.untracked: Materials you don't count yet stay as they are: costed at the average of your last 90 days of purchases.
empty.untracked_food: Ingredients and supplies you don't count yet stay as they are: costed at the average of your last 90 days of purchases.
empty.untracked_factory: Raw materials you don't count yet stay as they are: costed at the average of your last 90 days of purchases.
empty.untracked_retail: Items you don't count yet stay as they are: costed at the average of your last 90 days of purchases.
empty.viewer: No stock is tracked yet. Someone who manages counts starts it with a first count.
empty.everyBranch: A first count covers every branch on the same day, so it is started by someone who works in every branch.

start.title: Start tracking your stock
start.description: Pick what to count first. You can add more later with another first count.
start.dayHint: Count the stock as it is at the end of this day, in every branch.
start.dayHintOne: Count the stock as it is at the end of this day.
start.dayRule: Nothing may be recorded for what you pick after this day, so today is usually best.
start.onDraft: Already on a draft first count
start.tooMany: One first count can take up to {{max}} of them, so the first {{max}} are picked. Start another first count for the rest.
start.overMax: One first count can take up to {{max}} of them. Untick some, and start another first count for the rest.
start.allTracked: You already track the stock of everything you have. Anything new can go on a later first count.

newCount.title: Count stock
newCount.description: Count what is on the shelf. BizCost then shows what differs from what it expected.
newCount.dayHint: Count the stock as it is at the end of this day.
newCount.all_food: All the ingredients and supplies you track
newCount.all_factory: All the raw materials you track
newCount.afterLast: Pick a day after {{date}}: {{name}} was last counted on that day.
newCount.nothingTracked: Nothing is tracked yet. Start with a first count.

counts.intro: Counts of what is on the shelf. A draft changes nothing until it is finalized.
counts.introCounter: Counts waiting for you: count what is on the shelf and save each line.

empty.title: No counts yet
empty.body: Start a count to compare what is on the shelf with what BizCost expects.
empty.counter: Nothing to count right now. When a manager starts a count, it shows here.

sheet.title: Count of {{date}}
sheet.blindNote: Count what you see on the shelf and save each line. Others can count this sheet at the same time.
sheet.openingNote: A first count: count each material in every branch. Finalizing it starts tracking their stock.
sheet.openingNote_food: A first count: count each ingredient and supply in every branch. Finalizing it starts tracking their stock.
sheet.openingNote_factory: A first count: count each raw material in every branch. Finalizing it starts tracking their stock.
sheet.openingNote_retail: A first count: count each item in every branch. Finalizing it starts tracking their stock.
sheet.conflict: Someone else saved this line just now. It shows what they counted.
sheet.gone: A manager finalized this count or took this line off it, so it can't be saved. The page now shows the count as it is.
sheet.removeBody: It won't be counted on this count, and whatever was typed or counted for it here is dropped. You can add it again while the count is a draft.
sheet.noLines: Nothing is on this count. Add materials to count, or discard it.
sheet.noLines_food: Nothing is on this count. Add ingredients or supplies to count, or discard it.
sheet.noLines_factory: Nothing is on this count. Add raw materials to count, or discard it.
sheet.noLines_retail: Nothing is on this count. Add items to count, or discard it.
sheet.notYours: Nothing on this count is in your branches.

add.title: Add materials
add.description: They are added to this count, in its branch.
add.openingDescription: They are added to this first count, in every branch.
add.nothing: Everything you can add is on this count already.

review.title: Review the count
review.intro: What was counted, next to what BizCost expected at the end of {{date}}. If a line looks wrong, ask for it to be counted again.
review.openingIntro: What each material starts at once finalized: what was counted in every branch together, at the average of the last 90 days of purchases. A first count has nothing to compare with yet.
review.openingIntro_food: What each ingredient and supply starts at once finalized: what was counted in every branch together, at the average of the last 90 days of purchases. A first count has nothing to compare with yet.
review.openingIntro_factory: What each raw material starts at once finalized: what was counted in every branch together, at the average of the last 90 days of purchases. A first count has nothing to compare with yet.
review.openingIntro_retail: What each item starts at once finalized: what was counted in every branch together, at the average of the last 90 days of purchases. A first count has nothing to compare with yet.
review.notCountedHint: Count these, or take them off the count, before finalizing.
review.missingTitle: Branches not on this count yet
review.missingHint: A first count covers every branch. Add the new branch and count these there, then finalize.
review.branchAdded: Added to the count. Count them there, then finalize.
review.noPrice: No price yet: it starts at no value until its first purchase.
review.conflict: Someone changed this count in the meantime. Look at it again, then try again.
review.changed: Lines were counted or changed since you looked. Look at the review again, then finalize.
review.differenceNote: A difference is usage nobody explained yet. It isn't anyone's fault: a missed entry, a spill or a count mistake can all cause one.

confirm.finalizeBody_other: The stock of {{count}} materials in {{branch}} will be set to what was counted at the end of {{date}}.

confirm.finalizeBodyHere_other: The stock of {{count}} materials will be set to what was counted at the end of {{date}}.
confirm.finalizeBodyHere_food_one: The stock of {{count}} ingredient or supply will be set to what was counted at the end of {{date}}.
confirm.finalizeBodyHere_food_other: The stock of {{count}} ingredients and supplies will be set to what was counted at the end of {{date}}.
confirm.finalizeBodyHere_factory_one: The stock of {{count}} raw material will be set to what was counted at the end of {{date}}.

confirm.diffSome_one: {{count}} of them differs from what was expected.
confirm.diffSome_other: {{count}} of them differ from what was expected.
confirm.diffLess: The difference, {{amount}} less than expected, counts on {{date}} as a stock count difference.
confirm.diffMore: The difference, {{amount}} more than expected, counts on {{date}} as a stock count difference.
confirm.diffZero: Together their value comes to {{amount}}, so what the stock is worth doesn't change.
confirm.diffHidden: Any difference counts on {{date}} as a stock count difference.
confirm.finalizeNote: A finalized count can be reversed while it is the latest count of everything on it.
confirm.openingBody_one: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} material from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_other: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} materials from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_food_one: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} ingredient or supply from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_food_other: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} ingredients and supplies from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_factory_one: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} raw material from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_factory_other: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} raw materials from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_retail_one: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} item from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingBody_retail_other: BizCost will track the stock of {{count}} items from the end of {{date}}, starting at what was counted in every branch.
confirm.openingValue: It starts worth {{amount}}, at the average of the last 90 days of purchases, so your product costs stay the same.
confirm.openingValueHidden: It starts at the average of the last 90 days of purchases, so your product costs stay the same.
confirm.finalized: Count finalized. The stock is set to what was counted.
confirm.openingFinalized: First count finalized. BizCost now tracks this stock.
confirm.closed: The books are closed through {{date}}, so this day can't be finalized.
confirm.discardBody: This draft count and everything typed in it will be deleted. Your stock doesn't change.
confirm.reverseBody_one: The stock of {{count}} material goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_other: The stock of {{count}} materials goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_food_one: The stock of {{count}} ingredient or supply goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_food_other: The stock of {{count}} ingredients and supplies goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_factory_one: The stock of {{count}} raw material goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_factory_other: The stock of {{count}} raw materials goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_retail_one: The stock of {{count}} item goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseBody_retail_other: The stock of {{count}} items goes back to what it was before this count, as if it was never finalized. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_one: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} material, and its cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_other: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} materials, and their cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_food_one: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} ingredient or supply, and its cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_food_other: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} ingredients and supplies, and their cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_factory_one: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} raw material, and its cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_factory_other: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} raw materials, and their cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_retail_one: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} item, and its cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseOpeningBody_retail_other: BizCost stops tracking the stock of {{count}} items, and their cost goes back to the average of your last 90 days of purchases. The reversal is dated {{date}}.
confirm.reverseNote: A count can be reversed only while it is the latest count of everything on it.
confirm.reverseClosed: The books are closed through today, so nothing can be reversed until tomorrow or until they are opened.

view.finalNote: Finalized on {{date}}. The stock was set to what was counted at the end of {{day}}.
view.openingFinalNote: Finalized on {{date}}. Their stock is tracked from the end of {{day}}.
view.reversedNote: Reversed on {{date}}. It no longer counts.
view.notFoundBody: It may have been discarded, or it isn't open to you.

card.intro: Everything that came in and went out, newest first.
card.empty: Nothing came in or went out since the first count.
card.notTracked: The stock of this material isn't tracked
card.notTracked_food: The stock of this ingredient or supply isn't tracked
card.notTracked_factory: The stock of this raw material isn't tracked
card.notTracked_retail: The stock of this item isn't tracked
